entry.summary:
TL;DR
The pyaction container is a Python slim Docker container with the addition of the GitHub CLI, git, curl, and gpg. Its original motivation was to support developing GitHub Actions with Python, but pyaction can also be used for other purposes (e.g., as an alternate way of using the GitHub CLI). Due to several requests from pyaction users, who wanted to use it with earlier Python versions, we recently changed the tagging convention. The Docker tags for pulling pyaction now include tags specifying the version of Python, and optionally the version of the GitHub CLI that are included in the image. entry.summary: Introduction Designing a signup and login feature seems straightforward at first glance: collect user credentials, store them, and verify them later. But the way you store and handle passwords can make or break the security of your entire application. entry.title: The road to artificial general intelligence
